summary: Clean only the Cargo registry archive cache from the scanned directory

delivery.outcome: Run the Cargo registry archive cache cleanup without the unsupported Cargo CLI option.
nonGoals: Change which Cargo data is selected for cleanup.

architecture.decision: Use the existing archive cache removal command directly so Cargo CLI compatibility does not affect cleanup.

validation.evidence: The Cargo cleanup command addresses the exact registry archive cache.
